name: Expert Healing
body:
You can use a healing kit to heal damage.

Prerequisite: 3 ranks in Heal.

Benefit: You may treat recent injuries received by living corporeal creatures by expending one use of a healer’s kit and taking 1 minute (10 rounds) to treat the creature, healing 1d4 hp damage (DC 20). You may heal an additional 1d4 for each 10 points by which you exceeded the target number on your skill check. You may not heal more damage than the target has taken in the previous 10 minutes. A given target may receive 1 healing/10 minutes.

Notes: A full healer’s kit contains 10 uses.
